method: Unmodified egret.flap and egret.fly from pinned scEGRET source, executed in R/WebR

design.inputs: Separate word and line transition features; TPM-like counts per million per profile as primary, raw event counts as a length sensitivity control.
design.pseudotime: Saved segment-projected normalized arclength; original Golf spline also included.
design.interpretation: Source-code scEGRET continuity screening applied to text features; no biological cutoff transferred.

execution_note: Disjoint feature batches ran in parallel. Completed batches from two serial workers were preserved before stopping redundant continuation; partially evaluated overlap is not retained. One separate instrumented original-function case diagnosed runtime. Main scientific results contain648 unique evaluations, not duplicate runs.

output_label_normalization.reason: The executing wrapper used as.integer(TimeBin), which exports compressed factor codes after droplevels. Map through every occupied original bin; preserve codes separately. No score or membership changed.
